hero.title: Join the Junior Enterprise Movement
hero.subtitle: A dynamic network of student-entrepreneurs across Tunisia, serving JEs and future Junior Creations.

history.title: History of the movement
history.subtitle: A journey that began in 1967 in France, now spread worldwide and across Tunisia.

items.text: Création de la première JE au sein d'ESSEC Paris.
Création de la CNJE (Confédération Nationale des JE françaises).
Stratégie de développement massif des JE sur plus de 10 ans.
Accord de coopération global Europe–Brésil, création du JEWC.
Création de la CTJE, annonce parue au JORT n°59 du 16/05/2013.
Création du JE Global Council lors du Global Forum.
Finalisation du projet juridique de la CTJE.
Certification ISO 9001:2015 de la CTJE dans 4 prestations de service.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A student movement dedicated to professional integration and entrepreneurship.
about.mission: To help young students take their first steps into professional life and grow their skills by carrying out real projects in their field of study.
about.vision: To be a leading movement supporting young students in their transition into professional life, creating value within their professional or entrepreneurial ecosystem.
about.how: Junior Enterprises are non-profit student associations run like professional consulting firms. They put their members' skills to work for real clients through competitive services, allowing students to gain valuable hands-on experience during their studies.
domains: Soutien aux organisations à travers des projets
